# DPA · SDT — Self Declared Token | Decentralized Partnership Agreement: full reference

## Overview
Synthetic-only Base Sepolia research prototype for DPA and SDT.
Author: Maxim Osovsky.
Author profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/osovsky/
Repository: https://github.com/maximosovsky/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT
Published website: https://maximosovsky.github.io/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/
Read-only example: https://maximosovsky.github.io/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/dpa.html?example=1

## Repository scope
This public repository contains only compiled website files.
Application source and development history are maintained separately in a private repository.
Publication is manual, not automatically synchronized with the private source.
Editing this repository does not rebuild the application.
No package manifest, source-build instructions or contract source are supplied here.
Do not infer original framework versions or source tooling from the bundles.

## Core concepts
SDT means Self-Declared Token.
An SDT links a wallet to a declaration digest.
It is not independently verified identity, a verified passport or a unique-person certificate.
No bank issues or verifies the SDT.
DPA means Decentralized Partnership Agreement.
A DPA records a version and hash of separate off-chain terms.
It also records named participant wallets, allocations and individual acceptances.
Signatures and hashes do not by themselves prove personal identity or legal enforceability.
The research's separate pre-authenticated identity route is not implemented.

## Interface features
- Local drafting of fictional agreement terms and allocations.
- Invitation review and evidence inspection before connecting a wallet.
- Read-only public example without a wallet.
- Local hashing of predefined synthetic SDT declaration fields.
- Wallet-based testnet deployment and acceptance, subject to chain and contract checks.
- Participation records and unit claims.
- Downloadable local evidence copies.
- Separate share-sale and collateral/loan research experiments.
- Public privacy notice, terms of use and operator contact pages.

## Technical details
Published pages are static HTML with compiled browser JavaScript and CSS.
Wallet interactions use Ethereum-compatible RPC workflows.
The public test network is Base Sepolia, chain ID 84532.
The site also describes an isolated local-chain testing mode, chain ID 31337.
Serving static files locally does not start that local blockchain.
GitHub Pages URLs include the repository name as a base path.
No signing key is embedded in the published page, according to its interface notice.
SDT v2 hashes bind all 13 exact entered synthetic declaration fields.
Historical SDT v1 records use the original four fields and are unchanged.
A public unsalted hash may enable guessing; it is not encryption.

## Public example and integrity
The interface describes two synthetic wallets that individually accepted an agreement.
Claimed allocation: 6,000 / 4,000 of 10,000 units (60 / 40).
No sale or loan occurred in this pilot.
Agreement contract: https://sepolia.basescan.org/address/0xB23Ed35bf06D90FF197d00f0792f918808794ecd
Units contract: https://sepolia.basescan.org/address/0xe604299A2166A5cAE3E72Cd1df25427F06094821
Archived text: https://github.com/maximosovsky/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/blob/main/synthetic-offchain-agreement-exact.txt
Keep the archived document bytes unchanged.
Its on-chain document reference remains the existing Vercel URL.
The GitHub Pages archive is not a replacement of that on-chain reference.
A hash does not preserve lost document text; retain exact evidence independently.

## Quick start
The public website and example can be read without installation or a wallet.
For local static preview, install Git and Python 3, then run from a parent directory:

git clone https://github.com/maximosovsky/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT.git
python -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1

Open http://127.0.0.1:8000/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/
Do not start the server inside the clone: compiled asset paths include the repository name.
There is no npm install or development-source build command in this snapshot.
Signing requires a browser wallet, supported test network and verified contract configuration.

## Safety and limitations
Use fictional fixtures and free test ETH only.
Never enter real identity or banking data.
Never provide private keys, seed phrases or passwords.
Do not present this prototype as identity verification or legal certification.
Do not represent units or acceptances as guaranteed enforceable rights.
Do not use real funds or describe the public pilot as a completed sale or loan.
A local evidence download saves a separate copy and does not clear the open form.
Do not post sensitive information in issues or pull requests.
